records.method: protocol demonstration: StreamCat values for four SFARI field sites scored through the published landscape curves, banded, compared with the SFARI function scores banded at 5 and 10
records.outcome: no per-curve support claimed: chance-corrected agreement near zero on unique site-metric values, curves read harsher than the field scores (the least-disturbed offset), four-site ranking agrees on the strongest and the degraded site only

dataset_provenance.dataset: SFARI field assessments in or near ecoregion 58 (Slade Brook NH, Mink Brook NH, Tributary to Sugar River NH, Kenduskeag River ME)

independence.sites: independent of the NRSA development data
independence.variables: shared: the same StreamCat values on both sides
independence.evidence_values: possibly shared: SFARI's desktop layer can pre-fill suggested scores from the same values, and the site reports do not record whether they were used
independence.tool_lineage: shared: the SFARI corpus validated the EASI engine that screens the reference pools

design_approval.gate: Phase 6 design gate, before any conclusion was drawn
design_approval.measures: band agreement at the 0.39 and 0.69 breaks; Phase 8 recast added chance expectations, linear-weighted kappa, Spearman correlation with sign, per-site aggregation, permutation p
design_approval.acceptance_threshold: none claimed at 16 and 4 sites; the only decision rule was below-chance agreement or a systematically opposite direction
design_approval.recast: Phase 8 (adversarial review VAL-1, VAL-2, STAT-11): reported as a protocol demonstration with no per-curve support

history.note: Exploratory field comparison only; not validation
